researchLanes.responsibility: Bind effective multicore profile, generated closure, compiler and runtime ABI; distinguish build jobs from runtime parallelism

pressures.evidenceBoundary: Historical reported crash; current source correspondence and native composition remain separate
pressures.structuralCoupling: An asynchronous outcome can outlive the catcher or execution context selected to receive it
pressures.repairLimit: A NULL guard alone can suppress a crash while losing an admitted outcome
pressures.replacement: Explicit admission, retained outcome owner, drain and late-result disposition before receiver reclamation
pressures.retirement: Remove implicit live-catcher assumption only after every legal sender and unwind path has a disposition
pressures.benefitMeasures: Lost outcomes; retained descriptors; completion latency
pressures.newCosts: Retention and handoff synchronization; no zero-cost claim

pressures.problem: GC work owner versus processor lifetime
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Current source aliases collector queues, cursors and RC lists through PSTATE
pressures.structuralCoupling: Execution identity, collector storage, work custody and participation are coupled
pressures.repairLimit: A per-site barrier or queue patch need not define last producers and post-exit consumers
pressures.replacement: Explicit collector work context, producer closure and retained custody carrier with last-use reclamation
pressures.retirement: Replace collector PSTATE aliases only after all roots, phase producers, resize paths and consumers are mapped
pressures.benefitMeasures: Barrier wait; orphan work; retained bytes; synchronization per collection
pressures.newCosts: Additional descriptors and transfer traffic; independent workers remain unqualified

pressures.problem: Hidden copy progress and pending scan continuation
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Current winner forwarding precedes the payload copy loop; no current migration API inferred
pressures.structuralCoupling: Original slot, rebound Tail cell, payload progress and caller advance reside in local C control state
pressures.repairLimit: Fixing one scan cursor does not define a complete resumable nested initializer
pressures.replacement: Explicit phase-tagged copy subframe and parent continuation; preserve reservation before execution
pressures.retirement: Retire implicit local-state recovery only after exact progress, publication, rejection and unknown-outcome adapters qualify
pressures.benefitMeasures: Lost or duplicate scan work; redundant copies; descriptor bytes; resume overhead
pressures.newCosts: Frame materialization and custody accounting; no requirement to materialize at every word

pressures.problem: Foreign entry roots and callback ownership
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Current pinned source includes a TODO about proc_or_false across marker allocation; reachability requires callers
pressures.structuralCoupling: Marker creation can allocate before its incoming Scheme value is independently protected
pressures.repairLimit: A marker-site repair does not enumerate all callback roots, nested entries or VM binding restoration
pressures.replacement: Generated root-safe entry plans with explicit owner, borrowed slots, block participation and acquired-effect cleanup
pressures.retirement: Retire handwritten per-entry root choreography only after complete caller and exceptional-exit coverage
pressures.benefitMeasures: Uncovered entry writers; root publications; callback entry and blocked-GC costs
pressures.newCosts: Root slots, entry guards and revalidation; C still needs a moving-GC protocol

pressures.problem: Foreign cleanup effects and resource lifetime
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Current collector calls foreign release before freeing still objects; no current error-policy violation inferred
pressures.structuralCoupling: Arbitrary external effects, collector progress and native resource lifetime meet inside cleanup
pressures.repairLimit: An at-most-once release guard alone does not specify thread affinity, blocking or derived tasks
pressures.replacement: Effect-classified release service, explicit wait context and shutdown accounting for accepted descendants
pressures.retirement: Retire inline cleanup only for declared resource classes after payload roots, task acceptance and final drain close
pressures.benefitMeasures: Collector blocking; queued and in-flight releases; shutdown backlog; retained bytes
pressures.newCosts: Queues and longer resource retention; ineligible finalizers must retain another explicit route

pressures.problem: Cached frame state across GC-capable boundaries
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Current source already orders RA store, W_ALL, call, R_ALL and RA reload; historical fix is not missing here
pressures.structuralCoupling: Compiler cache, physical frame, collector relocation and return interpretation must agree
pressures.repairLimit: Reapplying the existing wrapper cannot prove all generated hosts or continuations safe
pressures.replacement: One Scheme-owned FrameSpec and checkpoint contract generates C root writeback, reload and unwind metadata
pressures.retirement: Retire duplicate frame decisions after every generator/runtime consumer shares schema and preserves supported continuations
pressures.benefitMeasures: Duplicated semantic decisions; metadata mismatch; safepoint spill/reload and continuation costs
pressures.newCosts: Metadata and spills; Gambit control semantics must be retained rather than copied from OCaml

pressures.problem: Requested SMP versus effective native capability
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Separate VM, same-VM threads and scheduler switches; missing thread backend can force single-thread configuration
pressures.structuralCoupling: Requested options, effective headers, linked RTS and runtime population can diverge
pressures.repairLimit: A successful build or make -j does not prove shared-VM multicore capability
pressures.replacement: Typed effective profile and ABI-bound artifact graph, audited target projections and one shared CPU budget
pressures.retirement: Retire string-only capability inference after configured-header, object, link and runtime witness coverage
pressures.benefitMeasures: Mismatched artifacts; regenerated bytes; compile jobs; CPU oversubscription; actual runtime processors
pressures.newCosts: Variant keys and stronger invalidation; avoid invalidating semantic plans on irrelevant compiler changes

pressures.problem: Scheme to generated C and linked runtime coherence
pressures.evidenceBoundary: Historical closed unmerged PR with retracted body; source inventory is useful, its success claims are not acceptance
pressures.structuralCoupling: Scheme source, generated type/label identities, archive and executable are one affected dependency closure
pressures.repairLimit: A reported interpreter or selected stress pass need not use the same runtime as compiled code
pressures.replacement: Single semantic plan, generated declarations and manifests; bind the affected generated/header/link closure
pressures.retirement: Retire manually synchronized emission/layout decisions after all consumers regenerate and reject stale closure
pressures.benefitMeasures: Semantic owners per decision; stale links admitted; generation and C compilation work
pressures.newCosts: Generator and schema maintenance; a new wrapper without owner retirement adds cost
